### 艺术史与文化

Groups: 14 · Skills: 59

[artHistoryAndCultures.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artHistoryAndCultures/artHistoryAndCultures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Artworks and artistic practices develop within particular communities, historical debates, patrons and material technologies. Study of art history distinguishes movements and named traditions through their own works and contexts rather than treating an entire continent or historical era as a single skill. This domain examines art-historical interpretation, not general political chronology.

**User-friendly description (zh):** 探索艺术作品如何反映特定地点、社群、时代和艺术论争。

### 戏剧与戏剧艺术

Groups: 4 · Skills: 17

[theatreAndDramaticArts.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/theatreAndDramaticArts/theatreAndDramaticArts.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Theatre creates meaning through embodied roles, dramatic situations, live collaboration and staging. Its practical focus differs from general literary theory or building stage machinery.

**User-friendly description (zh):** 探索演员、故事、舞台呈现与协作如何让现场戏剧焕发生机。

Skills: 5

**User-friendly description (zh):** 运用身体、声音和回应，让角色真实可信。

**Methodological description (English):** Identify what a performed figure wants in a given scene and how that guides actions.

**User-friendly description (zh):** 确定角色想要什么，以及这如何影响其行动。

[expressCharacterThroughGesture.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/theatreAndDramaticArts/acting/skills/expressCharacterThroughGesture.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (zh):** 通过姿态和手势展现角色的感受或意图。

[maintainStagePresence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/theatreAndDramaticArts/acting/skills/maintainStagePresence.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (zh):** 在整个表演过程中保持专注和角色状态的一致。

[useExpressiveStageVoice.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/theatreAndDramaticArts/acting/skills/useExpressiveStageVoice.data.ts)
